To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the use of an LMS for TEL in vocational training has to be carefully considered.
the LMS is used by the trainees in a limited manner.
the use of the Learning Management System is limited to the training of the apprentices.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the following questions: What are critical incidents in the use of TEL? What are critical incidents for TEL?
the following research question: What are the Critical Incidents for TEL in VET?

the following aspects: (1) How is the LMS used by the learners in the companies? (2) How do the learners perceive the LMS? (3) What kind of incidents can be observed? (4) How can these incidents be classified?
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the LMS is not suitable for the assistance in typical tasks of the apprenticeship.
the LMS is not used as intended, but that it is used as a communication medium.
the CIT is a very suitable instrument for the identification and analysis of critical incidents in the domain of TEL in VET.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the application of the CIT is a valuable approach for observations in the domain of Vocational Education and training.
a LMS is a useful tool to support the training in the workplace and that it is important to take into account the specific requirements of the domain.
a Learning Management System (or similar tools) is an important tool for the support of vocational education and training.
The main takeaway from our work is that
TEL can be a useful tool to support the learning process in the apprenticeship in VET.
a LMS is a valuable instrument for the support of the apprenticeship in the VET in mechanical engineering companies.
the CIT is a useful tool to analyze the use of TEL in the VET context.
